integrity.claim_scope: Finite simple connected complete multipartite graphs with at least three nonempty parts and one part size at least two; ordinary power domination on their line graphs.
integrity.new_claim_not_included: Previously established rook-graph and triangular-graph cases are not claimed new.
integrity.proof_type: Elementary complete-case graph argument and endpoint-support inclusion-exclusion

scientific_limitations: The new domain is r >= 3 with at least one nonsingleton part; prior exact work covers the bipartite rook and all-singleton triangular boundary cases. A 2011 line-graph thesis was not fully inspectable, leaving an explicit priority risk. Exhaustive calculations verify finite cases but do not replace the general proof.
title: Zero-or-one-round power domination and exact bivariate enumeration in multipartite line graphs
